_description: Session 109 verifier-robustness cells. We verify the 1-of-5 PROPOSER union once (per verifier temperature) at N iterations, then derive every proposer-vote input level (1of5..5of5) as a free post-hoc subset (the union geojson carries vote_count per feature) AND the verifier-determinism analysis (avg-of-N single runs vs an N-run consensus verifier). Stage 1 = T=0.0 only; later stages add 0.3/0.7/1.0 one notch at a time.

cells.name: 384-flash-high-text-1of5-union
cells.note: The leading 384 GS consensus+PV proposer (flash-high-text). 63% of the 1of5 union is single-pass-only (vote_count=1) -> the FP-heavy permissive extreme.

cells.name: 256-text-1of5-union
cells.note: The 256 rescue cell (Obs 352). Smaller tiles benefit most from verifier efficacy; vote_count=5 dominates (1165).

_deferred_cells.name: 384-flash-high-image-1of5-union
_deferred_cells.status: PENCILLED — NOT YET RUN (separate gated tranche; not in the active cells[] list)
_deferred_cells.rationale: The image analogue of the winning text cell: same model (flash) + HIGH thinking, image modality. Likely the high-performing 384px image track. The verifier stays text-only (verify_adversarial-text.json) — Shawn confirmed an image-USING verifier was tested and did not help; only the PROPOSER modality differs.

cost_notes.decision_rule: Choose the proposer-vote band to verify from the TEXT-run patterns: if the permissive 1of5 union performs badly post-verifier (the verifier cannot rescue the single-pass FP flood), verify only the productive band (>=2of5 or >=3of5) rather than the full union, per Shawn (S109). Before the gated verify, score the image consensus-only F1 (free, on disk) to confirm it is high-performing, mirroring how the text cell's lineage was validated.
